sources.title: Qwen3.8-27B on Hugging Face: official repo download guide
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8 27B is on Hugging Face at Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B, published by the Qwe n org on August 14, 2026 under the Apache 2.0 license. The repo holds 55.6 GB of BF16 safetensors across 18 shards, plus the tokenizer, chat template, and config that go with it — free to download, free to use commercially, and no per-token fee.

sources.snippet: In-depth research analysis of Alibaba's Qwen3.8-27B (Aug 14, 2026): 27.8B parameters, beats Claude Opus 4.6 on 15 benchmarks, runs on 24GB VRAM. Complete architecture review and deployment guide.
